metadata.description: Tmux-based supervision and orchestration tooling for Claude Code and Codex CLI agents.

plugins.name: tmux-agent-tools
plugins.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agy or grok CLI as supervised tmux workers: skills, wrappers and the Bash dispatch gate. For Codex and Cursor it also registers the tmux-agent MCP server.

plugins.name: tmux-agent
plugins.description: Claude Code function-hook mod: assign/tell/stop/peek/keys tools, the /workers panel, and a collector that wakes the session when a worker finishes or fails to launch. Pair it with the tmux-agent-tools plugin or the global npx skills install (see mods/tmux-agent/README.md).
